sequenceReserved.markdownDescription:
Words that do not count as evidence of a source

Words that do not count as evidence of where a line comes from, such as `true`, `the`, `INFO` or `level`. A match made only of these words cannot pick a source.  Before the message these words are skipped, and a key from this list is skipped with its value, such as `level=info`. Words of the statement itself stay in the name as written.  The default lists `null`, `nil`, `true` and `false`. The shipped configuration adds common short words, severity levels and keys such as `timestamp` and `thread`. (Default: ["null","nil","true","false"])

enclosures.markdownDescription:
Brackets whose text before the message is skipped

Bracket pairs, each written as its open and close character. Text inside them before the message stays out of the name, such as `main` in `[main] Starting worker`.  An open bracket with no close in the same field is ignored, such as the `[` of a color code in `\033[0;33mWARN`. (Default: ["[]","()"])

assigners.markdownDescription:
Characters that join a quoted key to its value

Characters that join a key to its value when the key or the value is quoted, as in `"level":"info"` or `body: 'Charge request received.'`.  A [reserved](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolsequencereserved) key and its value stay out of the name, and the name starts inside a [message key](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolpreamblemessagekeys)'s value. Without quotes, `:` joins nothing, so `Error: 13 INTERNAL` and `INFO:root:Starting` keep their words. (Default: ["=",":"])

bareAssigners.markdownDescription:
Characters that also join an unquoted key to its value

Characters that join a key to its value without quotes, as logfmt writes them: `level=info`, `logger=cleanup`. They also work with quotes. (Default: ["="])

joiners.markdownDescription:
Separators that chain words into one name

Separators that chain words into one name without spaces, such as `org.apache.kafka.log.LocalLog` or `cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore`, usually a logger, class or file name.  Such a name stays in an event's name, since it often tells two statements apart. A line of a multi-line event that holds only such names does not name the event, see [symbolGroupLead](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolgrouplead). (Default: [".","::"])

messageKeys.markdownDescription:
Keys whose value holds the message

Keys whose value holds the message. The name starts at the value's first word outside brackets, such as `starting` in `msg=starting` or `Subchannel` in `"msg":"[core][Channel #1] Subchannel created"`.  In a record that opens with `{`, reading starts at the first of these keys that has a value. A message key with no value stays out of the name. (Default: ["msg","message","body"])

groupLead.markdownDescription:
Line of a multi-line event that names it

Which line of a multi-line event names it. The name, origin and skeleton all come from that line.  - `firstWithMessage`: the first line that holds message text. A line of only brackets, reserved keys and [joined](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolpreamblejoiners) names is passed over. The .NET console logger writes `info: cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore[0]` and then the message, so the second line names the event. A stack trace is named by its exception line. - `head`: always the first line. (Default: firstWithMessage)

maxOrigins.markdownDescription:
Most places in code compared for one phrase

The most places in code to compare for one phrase. A phrase such as `could not connect to` can appear in many files. The first ones in library order, by file name and then by unit name, are compared, so the same library picks the same origin on every node. (Accepts number or string with $= prefix for runtime evaluation) (Default: 64)

origins.markdownDescription:
Source files to log origin choices for

Source files in the symbol library, such as `foo.java`, for which to log how they take part in picking an event's origin. Set `*` for all files.

symbols.markdownDescription:
Words to log origin choices for

Words of a line, such as `MyClass` or `Could not connect to`, for which to log how their origin is picked. Set `*` for all of them.

loggerName.markdownDescription:
Logger for debug output

The log4j logger that [symbolDebugOrigins](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symboldebugorigins) and [symbolDebugSymbols](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symboldebugsymbols) write to. (Default: [consoleOut](https://github.com/log-10x/config/blob/main/log4j2.yaml#L66))
